criteria.name: Core Functionality
criteria.description: Implements add, remove, display, and task management features

levels.label: Complete
levels.description: All features work correctly: add tasks, remove tasks, display tasks, list numbering, and user menu/interaction

levels.label: Mostly Complete
levels.description: Most features work with minor bugs in one operation or display issues

levels.label: Partial
levels.description: Some features work but significant bugs in add, remove, or display functionality

levels.label: Minimal
levels.description: Most features don't work or program doesn't run

criteria.name: File Persistence
criteria.description: Saves and loads tasks from file correctly

levels.label: Excellent
levels.description: Correctly saves tasks to file and loads them back, handles missing files gracefully, maintains data format between runs

levels.label: Good
levels.description: File operations work but minor issues with file format or error handling

levels.label: Needs Improvement
levels.description: Basic file save/load but significant bugs, data corruption, or crashes on missing file

levels.label: Poor
levels.description: File persistence doesn't work or not implemented

criteria.name: Error Handling
criteria.description: Validates input and handles errors appropriately

levels.label: Comprehensive
levels.description: Validates user input, handles file I/O errors, prevents empty tasks, checks bounds for task removal with clear error messages

levels.label: Good
levels.description: Handles most errors but missing some validations or error messages could be clearer

levels.label: Basic
levels.description: Minimal error handling, allows some invalid operations, or crashes on bad input

levels.label: Excellent
levels.description: Well-organized with functions/classes, clear documentation and comments, good variable names, user-friendly interface with clear prompts

levels.label: Good
levels.description: Decent organization and documentation with minor issues in structure or interface

levels.label: Needs Improvement
levels.description: Poor organization, minimal documentation, confusing variable names, or unclear interface

levels.label: Poor
levels.description: No organization or documentation, all code in main, unclear interface
